description: For service providers: self-report your endpoint as LIVE right now. $0.005 via x402 (USDC on Base) — the settlement receipt is stored as your claim's proof. One report per service per 24h; LIVE renders as ALIVE for 24h, LIKELY ALIVE until 14 days, then UNTESTED; UseTested's own sweep results override self-reports. Input: your exact service name (from search_services, free) and status "LIVE".

service.description: Exact service name, as listed by search_services (free)

status.description: Must be exactly "LIVE" — self-reports cannot set DOWN or UNTESTED

name: report_pulse
title: Report your service as LIVE ($0.005)
